# CoSky

> Configuration management and service discovery for microservices: a small server in front of Redis, with clients that read from memory.

## Introduction

- [Overview](guide/index.md): What CoSky is, how it works, when it fits, and where to go next.
- [Getting Started](guide/getting-started.md): Run a CoSky server, serve a Config to a Spring Boot application, and find it from another one.

## Guides

- [Configuration](guide/configuration.md): Serve Spring properties from CoSky, refresh them live, and keep their revisions.
- [Service Discovery](guide/service-discovery.md): Register instances under a lease, find them through Spring Cloud, and understand what happens when things fail.
- [Using the SDK](guide/sdk.md): The Kotlin client without Spring, its snapshots and connection states, and clients for other languages.

## Operations

- [Deployment](guide/deployment.md): Run the CoSky server in production on Docker or Kubernetes, with what it asks of Redis.
- [Security](guide/security.md): Sign in with tokens or OIDC, say who may do what with roles, encrypt the connections, and read the audit log.
- [Dashboard](guide/dashboard.md): What the web console does, how to sign in, and how it stays current.
- [Moving from 6.x](guide/upgrade-8.md): Move a CoSky 6.x installation to 8.0 in one cutover, with cosky-migrate.

## Reference

- [Configuration Properties](guide/properties.md): Every setting of the server and the Spring Boot starter, with its default.
- [REST API](guide/rest-api.md): The endpoints of the REST API and the conventions they share.
- [Requirements](guide/requirements.md): The versions CoSky needs and is tested with.

## Concepts

- [Architecture](guide/architecture.md): The data model, how changes travel, and what happens when parts of the system fail.
- [Performance](guide/performance.md): The targets of CoSky 8.0, what was measured, and what was not.

## Contributing

- [Internals](guide/internals.md): How the repository is organized and tested, for those working on CoSky itself.
